name: OS Command Injection
description: Usage of Runtime.exec() or ProcessBuilder with untrusted data can lead to OS command injection.
fixSuggestion: Use parameterized APIs and validate input strictly. Avoid passing user input to OS shells.

name: SQL Injection
description: Potential SQL Injection via unparameterized query execution.
fixSuggestion: Always use PreparedStatement instead of Statement for parameterized SQL.

name: Insecure Deserialization
description: Use of ObjectInputStream can lead to arbitrary code execution.
fixSuggestion: Avoid native Java serialization. Use secure formats like JSON.

name: Weak Cryptography
description: Usage of weak hashing algorithm (MD5/SHA1) or encryption mode (DES/ECB).
fixSuggestion: Use SHA-256/SHA-512 for crypto, bcrypt/Argon2 for passwords, and AES/GCM for encryption.

name: Hardcoded Credentials
description: Potential hardcoded password/secret detected.
fixSuggestion: Use environment variables, HashiCorp Vault, or AWS Secrets Manager.

name: Information Disclosure
description: Calling printStackTrace() or printing sensitive info exposes internal application details.
fixSuggestion: Use a logging framework (e.g., SLF4J, Logback) and log at ERROR level instead.

name: Weak Randomness
description: java.util.Random produces predictable values.
fixSuggestion: Use java.security.SecureRandom for cryptographic or security-sensitive RNG.

name: XML External Entity (XXE)
description: Insecure XML parser configuration can lead to XXE.
fixSuggestion: Disable DOCTYPE processing or disallow external entities on DocumentBuilderFactory.

name: Path Traversal
description: Unvalidated input passed to File constructors may allow path traversal.
fixSuggestion: Validate file paths, restrict to expected directories, or use Path.normalize().

name: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)
description: Constructing a URL with user input can lead to SSRF.
fixSuggestion: Validate URLs against a strict allowlist. Do not allow users to specify arbitrary hosts.

name: Missing Secure Cookie
description: Cookie is created without setting the Secure flag.
fixSuggestion: Always set cookie.setSecure(true) and cookie.setHttpOnly(true).

name: LDAP Injection
description: Unsanitized input in LDAP search query can lead to LDAP Injection.
fixSuggestion: Use parameterized queries for LDAP or properly escape LDAP specific characters.

name: Unsafe Reflection
description: Instantiating classes by name via reflection can lead to RCE.
fixSuggestion: Avoid reflection with user-supplied data or validate against a strict whitelist.

name: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
description: User-controlled data written directly to HTTP response without encoding leads to XSS.
fixSuggestion: HTML-encode all user input before writing to response. Use OWASP Java Encoder or Thymeleaf th:text.

name: Open Redirect
description: Redirect destination built from user input enables phishing via unvalidated redirect.
fixSuggestion: Use an allowlist of permitted redirect targets; never redirect to a user-supplied URL.

name: Sensitive Data in Logs
description: Logging sensitive fields (password, token, secret) exposes credentials in log files.
fixSuggestion: Mask or redact sensitive values before logging. Never log passwords, tokens, or API keys.

name: Weak JWT Secret
description: Short or hardcoded JWT signing secret makes tokens trivially forgeable.
fixSuggestion: Use a cryptographically random secret of at least 256 bits stored in environment variables.

name: Weak CORS Configuration
description: Wildcard CORS origin (*) allows any external site to make cross-origin requests.
fixSuggestion: Replace wildcard origins with an explicit allowlist of trusted domains.

name: Unsafe File Upload
description: File saved using original client-supplied filename without normalization enables path traversal.
fixSuggestion: Sanitize filenames, validate MIME type and extension, store under server-generated names.

name: HTTP Response Splitting
description: User-controlled values in HTTP response headers can inject additional headers or responses.
fixSuggestion: Strip CR (\r) and LF (\n) from any user input placed into response headers.

name: Debug Configuration Enabled
description: Debug flag enabled in source code may expose internal details in production environments.
fixSuggestion: Remove debug flags before production. Use Spring profiles to isolate development configuration.

name: OS Command Injection
description: Usage of os.system() or subprocess with shell=True allows command injection.
fixSuggestion: Use subprocess.run() with a list of arguments and shell=False.

name: SQL Injection
description: Potential SQL injection via string formatting or concatenation in execute().
fixSuggestion: Always use parameterized queries (e.g. execute("SELECT * FROM users WHERE id=?", (id,)))

name: Insecure Deserialization
description: pickle.load() is unsafe and can execute arbitrary code.
fixSuggestion: Use safe formats like JSON. Never unpickle untrusted data.

name: Directory Traversal
description: Unvalidated input used to access files can lead to Directory Traversal.
fixSuggestion: Validate file paths strictly and ensure they resolve within allowed directories.
